claim: The paginate function does not emit a partial final page when the total count is not a multiple of the page size.
summary: The fix correctly addresses the pagination bug by changing page_count to use ceiling division. However, the PR includes an unrelated new file pyproject.toml which is not mentioned in the spec.

findings.rule: No changes unrelated to the spec
findings.note: Adding pyproject.toml is unrelated to the pagination bug fix described in the spec.
